__comment: Grafana dashboard for the MOTS Supplier Portal. Every panel queries an instrument the application actually publishes - ASP.NET Core's own http_server_request_duration_seconds, AppMetrics' mots_rate_limit_rejections_total, and OutboxBacklogGauge's mots_outbox_backlog. Import with the Prometheus datasource that scrapes /metrics. See ops/README.md for what this does and does not show.

panels.title: Is it up, and is it answering
Requests per second
panels.description: All routes. A drop to zero on a weekday is the first thing to notice, and it is not the same as the process being down.

panels.title: 5xx share
panels.description: A ratio, not a count: a fixed count reads as calm on a quiet night in which everything is broken. The MotsPortalServerErrors alert pages above 2%.

panels.title: Read latency p95 by route
panels.description: Reads only, and that is a limitation rather than a choice: perf/BASELINE.md covers 18 reads and no write path has been measured (P12 item 22). Do not read this panel as a write-path SLO.

panels.title: The two failure modes this product actually has
Precondition refusals (428) and stale versions (412)
panels.description: 428 means the SPA sent a guarded write with no If-Match - a transport bug, not a user mistake. Batch 13 found five separate causes, each invisible until somebody pressed a button. 412 is the honest case: two people editing one record.

panels.title: Notification outbox backlog
panels.description: Pending rows. A burst is normal; a floor that does not fall is the dispatcher stuck, and nobody is being notified even though nothing has been lost.

panels.title: Rate-limit rejections by surface
panels.description: The limiter working is the system defending itself, so this is a watch rather than a page. Per-target on login is somebody being attacked; per-ip is usually one misbehaving client.

panels.title: Refusals: 401, 403 and 429
panels.description: A step change in 403 usually means a permission or a role seed moved - AuthorizationFuzzTests proves the gates refuse the wrong persona, not that the right one still gets through.
